Object.Name: EXACT Calibration Status
Object.Description1: Contains the current status and results of the calibration process, including pre- and post-adjustment values, reference values, and active calibration index.

Item.Name: Status
Item.Description: Status of the current calibration. Non-idle while the calibration is ongoing. Possible values: 0: Idle, 1: Pre-calibration value check, 2: Calibration in progress, 3: Post-calibration value check, 4: Data upload

Item.Name: Result
Item.Description: Result of the last performed calibration. Possible values: 0: Initial value/no status, 1: Calibration success, 2: Post-adjustment out of range, 3: Ambient temperature out of range, 4: Calibration unsuccessful, N: error n

Item.Name: Pre-adjustment values
Item.Description: Pre-adjustment values for all device ports at reference temperatures

Item.Name: Post-adjustment values
Item.Description: Post-adjustment values for all device ports at reference temperatures

Item.Name: Reference values
Item.Description: The list of reference temperatures for the pre- and post-adjustment values

Item.Name: Active Calibration
Item.Description: Index of the calibration that is currently in use
